en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large institutional brick complex along an unpaved road. The main foreground building is a massive red-brick structure with steep gabled roofs, dormers, and decorative brick courses. It has tall, narrow windows with arched tops, an external stair leading to a raised entrance, and is surrounded by a low stone wall with wrought‑iron fencing and regularly spaced posts. Similar multi‑storey brick buildings extend in a row into the distance, giving the impression of a planned campus or barracks. The foreground shows a dirt roadway with wheel ruts and open grass, suggesting an early 20th‑century urban edge. No visible printed or handwritten text appears on the image side.
